image_description: A high-angle, wide shot of an ornate church interior featuring a central altar. The altar is a complex structure with a white marble or stone base, draped with a white cloth, and topped with candles and floral arrangements. Behind the main table stands a large, elaborate altarpiece (reredos) with gold accents, columns, and religious iconography, set within a vaulted niche. The surrounding architecture includes arched ceilings, side windows letting in bright light, and framed artwork on the walls.

The vertical lines of the side windows and the framed pictures on the walls show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective convergence, not perfectly aligning with the central vanishing point.
The flowers on the altar lack distinct petal definition, appearing as smudged color blobs rather than individual flowers, indicative of generative blur in fine details.
